meta.title: Japan Financial Conditions Tracker
meta.framework: Bank of Japan Review 2026-E-4 (two-stage assessment of financial conditions)
meta.data_mode: LIVE (official sources) + SEED fallback for un-fetched series
meta.source_note: Seed values are illustrative approximations anchored to recent observations; run etl/fetch.py for authoritative data from BoJ/MoF/e-Stat/FRED.
meta.score_window: Most axes are z-scored over Jan 2005–present (monthly). The headline real-rate axis is scored over its LONGEST available history on an ex-post basis (nominal − realized core CPI; 1Y/3Y from 1974, 10Y from 1986); the 2005+ ex-ante read is shown as a reference. See the real-rate horizon table.

headline.assessment: The composite Financial Conditions Index reads +0.61 (accommodative relative to its 2005+ history), indicating that financial conditions remain accommodative even after the policy rate was raised to 0.98%. The real policy rate is about -1.72%, roughly 1.37pp below the midpoint natural-rate estimate (-0.36%), so on the natural-rate lens the stance is still accommodative; the six-model natural-rate band (-0.94% to +0.53%) means this read carries wide uncertainty. Horizon: the headline real-rate axis is now scored over its longest available history (ex-post, since 1974/1986), not the ZIRP/NIRP-dominated 2005+ window (kept as a reference). On that long baseline the real-rate stance is mildly accommodative; it reads broadly neutral versus 1990 and mildly restrictive only versus post-1995 baselines (see the horizon table). Other axes remain on 2005+ history.

reference.label: 2005+ ex-ante
reference.note: Reference only — biased toward 'restrictive'. Its 2005–present baseline is dominated by zero/negative interest-rate policy, so the average real rate is unusually low and any normalization scores above that depressed mean.

policy_rate.name: Uncollateralized Overnight Call Rate (policy rate)
policy_rate.notes: Uncollateralized overnight call rate, monthly average (BoJ Data Search FM02): the market rate the Bank steers to its target, and the policy rate of BoJ Review 2026-E-4. Target was raised to 0.50% Jan-2025, 0.75% Dec-2025, 1.00% Jun-2026.

jgb_1y.name: JGB Yield 1-Year
jgb_1y.notes: MoF reference interest rates (daily) aggregated to monthly.

infexp_1y.name: Inflation Expectations 1-Year (composite)
infexp_1y.notes: Tankan 'Outlook for General Prices' 1 year ahead; average of all enterprises all industries.

infexp_3y.name: Inflation Expectations 3-Year (composite)
infexp_3y.notes: Tankan 'Outlook for General Prices' 3 years ahead; average of all enterprises all industries.

infexp_10y.name: Inflation Expectations 5-Year (Tankan enterprises' outlook)
infexp_10y.notes: Tankan 'Outlook for General Prices' 5 years ahead; average of all enterprises all industries. The Tankan has no 10-year horizon so this longest survey horizon deflates the 10Y yield.

real_policy_rate.name: Real Policy Rate (policy rate minus 1y expected inflation)
real_policy_rate.notes: Real ex-ante policy rate. Compared with the natural rate to gauge the policy stance.

real_1y_xp.name: Real Interest Rate 1-Year (ex-post)
real_1y_xp.notes: Headline real 1y: nominal minus realized core CPI. Scored over longest history (1974+).

real_3y_xp.name: Real Interest Rate 3-Year (ex-post)
real_3y_xp.notes: Headline real 3y (2y-5y interp minus realized core CPI). Scored over longest history (1974+).

real_10y_xp.name: Real Interest Rate 10-Year (ex-post)
real_10y_xp.notes: Headline real 10y: nominal minus realized core CPI. Scored over longest history (1986+).

lending_rate.name: Average Contracted Interest Rate on New Loans
lending_rate.notes: Average contracted rate on new loans and discounts; domestically licensed banks. BoJ Data Search IR04.

cp_rate.name: CP Issuance Rate (3-month a-1 rated)
cp_rate.notes: NO LIVE SOURCE. The Bank's only CP yield series (FM02 STRACP2W/1M/3M) were discontinued after October 2009. IR04 DLLR2CIDBNL2 (new short-term loans and discounts) is a live substitute but changes the concept from a market rate to a bank rate, so it is left as a decision rather than a silent swap.

corp_bond_spread.name: Corporate Bond Spread (AA 10y over JGB)
corp_bond_spread.notes: NO LIVE SOURCE at the Bank. Issuance and secondary spreads are published by the JSDA and commercial vendors, not the BoJ Data Search. Seeded.

tankan_lend_large.name: Tankan Lending Attitude DI - Large Enterprises
tankan_lend_large.notes: DI = accommodative minus severe. Positive = accommodative.

tankan_lend_small.name: Tankan Lending Attitude DI - Small Enterprises
tankan_lend_small.notes: DI = accommodative minus severe. Positive = accommodative.

tankan_finpos_large.name: Tankan Financial Position DI - Large Enterprises
tankan_finpos_large.notes: DI = easy minus tight. Positive = easy.

tankan_finpos_small.name: Tankan Financial Position DI - Small Enterprises
tankan_finpos_small.notes: DI = easy minus tight. Positive = easy.

topix.name: TOPIX Index
topix.notes: NO LIVE SOURCE. TOPIX is a JPX index and is not carried in the BoJ Data Search; the free mirror tested is behind a bot challenge. Seeded, with month-end closes pinned to verified values (31 Aug 2026 = 4,156.29).

usdjpy.name: USD/JPY Exchange Rate
usdjpy.notes: Higher USDJPY = weaker yen = more accommodative for exporters/profits.

bank_lending_yoy.name: Bank Lending Outstanding (y/y %)
bank_lending_yoy.notes: BoJ MD11 carries the loan amounts (IR04 has only the rate charged on them) but publishes no ready-made y/y series and holds ~80 near-identical variants by borrower, account and bank group under an opaque DL prefix. The resolver refuses to guess between them, so this stays seeded with verified BoJ prints pinned (Jul-2026 +5.9%, Aug-2026 +5.8%, banks excl. shinkin). To finish: identify the exact series in the Data Search browser and add its code to sources.BOJ_API_SERIES.

cp_corpbond_yoy.name: CP and Corporate Bonds Outstanding (y/y %)
cp_corpbond_yoy.notes: NO LIVE SOURCE found. MD02 carries only commercial paper issued BY financial institutions, and FM05 covers government rather than corporate bonds. The concept needed here is CP and corporate bonds outstanding for non-financial corporates. Seeded.

core_cpi_yoy.name: Core CPI (ex-fresh food) y/y
core_cpi_yoy.notes: MIC CPI core (ex-fresh food). Context for 2% target.

potential_growth.name: Potential Growth Rate
potential_growth.notes: BoJ staff estimate, read from the published output-gap workbook (gap.xlsx, sheet data2) rather than the Data Search. Semi-annual by fiscal year, dated to the final quarter of the half it covers. Released on the third business day of January, April, July and October.

natural_rate_low.name: Natural Rate of Interest - Lower Bound

natural_rate_mid.name: Natural Rate of Interest - Midpoint
natural_rate_mid.notes: Midpoint of 6-model range. ~-0.2pct as of 2025Q3 (range center).

natural_rate_high.name: Natural Rate of Interest - Upper Bound
